title: Composed supervisory control: Inspection-window reject lockout -> Bounded up/down inventory counter

inputs.name: A_Rejected
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Current inspected item rejected

inputs.name: A_WindowSize
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Items per inspection window

inputs.name: A_RejectLimit
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Rejects allowed in one window

inputs.name: B_Capacity
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Maximum count, assumed positive

outputs.name: A_WindowCount
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Items in current window

outputs.name: A_RejectCount
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Rejects in current window

outputs.name: B_Conflict
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Add and Remove rose together

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: A_WindowSize is at least 1 and A_RejectLimit is non-negative.
Subsystem A: A_Rejected is sampled only on a rising A_Inspected edge.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: B_Capacity remains constant during a test and is positive.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: Each rising A_Inspected edge shall add one to A_WindowCount and, when A_Rejected is TRUE, one to A_RejectCount.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Completing A_WindowSize items shall pulse A_WindowComplete for one scan and then start a new zeroed window.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: If rejects in the completed window exceed A_RejectLimit, A_LockedOut shall latch TRUE.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: No new items shall be counted while A_LockedOut.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall clear counts, A_WindowComplete, and A_LockedOut.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: A lone rising B_AddItem edge increments B_Count when below B_Capacity.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((rose(B_AddItem) AND !rose(B_RemoveItem) AND prev(B_Count)<B_Capacity AND !B_Reset) -> B_Count=prev(B_Count)+1))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: A lone rising B_RemoveItem edge decrements B_Count when above zero.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((rose(B_RemoveItem) AND !rose(B_AddItem) AND prev(B_Count)>0 AND !B_Reset) -> B_Count=prev(B_Count)-1))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Simultaneous rising edges shall leave B_Count unchanged and set B_Conflict for one scan.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((rose(B_AddItem) AND rose(B_RemoveItem) AND !B_Reset) -> ((B_Count=prev(B_Count)) AND B_Conflict)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Count shall remain within zero and B_Capacity; B_Empty and B_Full reflect the boundaries.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_Count>=0) AND (B_Count<=B_Capacity) AND (B_Empty=(B_Count=0)) AND (B_Full=(B_Count>=B_Capacity))))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset shall clear B_Count and B_Conflict.
A TRUE A_LockedOut shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND B_Count=0 AND NOT B_Empty AND NOT B_Full AND NOT B_Conflict)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (B_Count=0 AND NOT B_Empty AND NOT B_Full AND NOT B_Conflict))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
